audit_type: read-only source architecture/capacity audit; no new benchmark or database observation

gaps.finding: Archive quota is checked only during background chunk publication, never as future-output credit in upload/create/complete. Ready archives have no automatic expiry; full archive quota can leave accepted body/response payload accumulating in PostgreSQL while more work is admitted.

Successful purge preserves all task/attempt rows, batch/file/idempotency history and generation/chunk tombstones. Failed/cancelled bodies and errors are not cleared. There is no retained-history count/age cap.

Publisher selects at most4 batches per API sweep, processes serially then sleeps25-35s; each purge call is one bounded page. No unarchived-byte/age/global-DB-high-water submission gate or measured backlog-drain capacity is implemented.

Completion still serializes per worker row, tenant/model queue row and batch counter row. Additional API replicas do not shard these locks. One-statement WAN transit is not itself the server lock hold time.
gaps.validation_needed: Disposable real-PG rate test with completion+claim+heartbeat+archiver/readers, one hot key vs many keys, observe lock/WAL/pool statistics; no115.74/s qualification was run for this audit

gaps.finding: SQL feature flags defaultFalse; the fallback completion uses multiple awaited SQL statements inside an explicit transaction. Runtime activation must be confirmed separately before applying SQL-path claims.
The worker buffers the engine HTTP response before JSON/usage validation. General internal HTTP byte limits bound a DB completion write but do not cap the preceding engine-to-worker response buffer.

implemented.property: Per-request limits apply before writes, including completion report body
implemented.scope: HTTP bytes/file row count/output cap; not aggregate completed-result bytes

implemented.property: External input quota and live task credits are transactionally reserved before object I/O
implemented.scope: tenant serialized input stored+reserved bytes and pending/running+held tasks; inline backend bypasses external input bytes quota

implemented.property: External input expiry and fenced object GC are bounded and read/upload-lease aware
implemented.scope: object storage quota can be released; SQL file/tombstone rows remain; maintenance enable flag/availability required

implemented.property: Archive object bytes are reserved transactionally and completed-payload purge is verified and paged
implemented.scope: bounded object bytes; safe offload only of completed body/response after ready manifest and reader checks

implemented.property: Enabled SQL completion is one autocommit statement transaction
implemented.scope: worker authentication adds no DB round trip; SQL completion flag controls selection of this path

proposed_v9_not_implemented_or_approved.atomicity: Database-owned counters/triggers in the task insert transaction cover concurrent/mixed APIs; over-cap insertion aborts whole batch/idempotency transaction.
proposed_v9_not_implemented_or_approved.bootstrap: Exact retained count and existing actual payload plus active response reservations; permit existing totals over limits while refusing new insert, leaving reads/reserved completions/purge available.
proposed_v9_not_implemented_or_approved.completion: Server canonical response-size check against pre-reserved bound; no ledger update or extra tenant lock on normal completion.
proposed_v9_not_implemented_or_approved.lock_order: Supported creation and archive purge already hold tenant lock first. Keep normal completion worker->queue->batch->task without ledger update; explicit admin deletion must prelock tenant/ledger before rows.
proposed_v9_not_implemented_or_approved.no_physical_storage_claim: Canonical JSON quota is a logical admission bound, not exact PostgreSQL heap/TOAST/index/WAL or provider physical-storage accounting.
proposed_v9_not_implemented_or_approved.payload_bound: Before task insertion charge exact canonical body bytes plus a fixed maximum response reservation; keep charge on complete/fail/cancel, release only proven cleared body/response or explicit deletion.
remaining_metadata_boundaries: task/attempt error JSON must have an explicit byte cap or separate charge
proposed_v9_not_implemented_or_approved.task_metadata_bound: Per-tenant retained_tasks hard cap counts active+success+failed+cancelled; only explicit approved deletion releases count.
